phase_prompt.summary: The entity stands as a solemn witness at the mechanical fringes of the world, observing the operations of the simulation's ingress gates. It is a moment of stillness and high-fidelity observation.
phase_prompt.prompt_block: A medium shot of the obsidian entity in profile, gazing up at a colossal, rotating gear mechanism in the sky. The entity's dark, glass-like skin reflects the cold blue light of the simulation's horizon. Internal fiber-optic veins pulse gently beneath the surface. The background is a blur of dark clouds and mechanical structures. The camera focus is razor-sharp on the entity's face, revealing the scrolling Geez text in the eye sockets. The mood is silent, heavy, and deeply dramatic, capturing the isolation of a system monitor in a vast, artificial world.
